mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE below 4.5% signals improving labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in 3 out of 4 consecutive months with UNRATE < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 2.0% triggers a monetary easing cycle, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in 3 out of 4 months following FEDFUNDS < 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 4.5% indicates weakening labor market conditions, leading to reduced corporate profits and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) in 3 out of 4 months with UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in GDPC1 (total demand) and HOUST (industrial production) signal robust economic activity, driving up corporate earnings and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 and HOUST are rising.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in FEDFUNDS coupled with rising CPIAUCSL (inflation expectations) signals a transitory inflation scenario, lowering real interest rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS falls and CPIAUCSL rises.

mechanism_narrative: Rising PAYEMS (labor employment) alongside UNRATE signals a tight labor market, boosting corporate profits and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both PAYEMS and UNRATE are rising.

mechanism_narrative: In an 'expanding supply conditions' regime, a sustained rise in INDPRO above 107.0% signals increased production capacity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in 3 out of 4 months with INDPRO > 107.0% during the regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDPC1 (total demand) above 16455.1 (2023 Q1 level) signals robust economic activity, leading to short-term S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when GDPC1 exceeds 16455.1.
